sections.description: The core bridge between Exacoat Manager ERP, WooCommerce orders, custom status, and fulfillment tracking.
sections.changelog:
### Version 0.1.39
- Added native Exacoat Email Engine templates for customer cashback earned and store credit balance reminder
- Integrated Exacoat_Store_Credit_Manager with Action Scheduler for automated 7-day post-cashback follow-ups
- Suppressed unstyled Advanced Coupons default WooCommerce emails to route all notifications through Zoho ZeptoMail API
- Added dynamic order cashback resolution supporting ACFW coupon definitions, meta keys, and user balance lookups
